The '''Outer Rim Oreworks Market''', or '''ORO Market''', was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Apatros/Legends|Apatros]] and served as a place for [[Miner/Legends|workers]] to buy supplies. In [[1003 BBY]], it was the only store on Apatros.

==Description==
The Outer Rim Oreworks Market was located on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Apatros/Legends|Apatros]] in the [[Apatros (colony)|colony of the same name]]. ORO fastened a [[Color/Legends|black-and-white]] sign to the wall outside the store that displayed its [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] of operation. The ORO Market only stocked basic items, such as supplies for [[Miner/Legends|miners]] and the goods sold at the store were all overpriced. Store credit was available to customers, but it was advanced against future wages, and the interest rates that ORO charged were extremely high. As a result, workers were often forced to take extra shifts in the company's [[Cortosis/Legends|cortosis]] [[Mining/Legends|mines]] on Apatros to pay off the extra debt they incurred by taking store credit.<ref name="PoD" />

==History==
The store was owned and operated by the [[Outer Rim Oreworks Company]] and was the only store located on Apatros<ref name="PoD" /> in [[1003 BBY]].<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the first events of ''[[Darth Bane: Path of Destruction]]'', including the mention of the ORO Market, to [[1003 BBY]].</ref> The building the store occupied was once a [[Barracks/Legends|barracks]], but it had been converted into a place for workers to buy supplies. The [[Shower/Legends|shower]] that had been located in the building was converted into a secure storage room, and the [[Bunk/Legends|bunks]] had been replaced by shelves.<ref name="PoD" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ORO Market was mentioned in the novel ''[[Darth Bane: Path of Destruction]]'', written by [[Drew Karpyshyn]] as the first installment of the ''[[Star Wars: Darth Bane Trilogy]]'', published in [[2006]].<ref name="PoD" />
